command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
since=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "round" && $4 !~ /^implement#/ { print $1; exit }')
start=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "task" && $4 == "started" { print $1; exit }')
[ -n "$since" ] || since=$(git rev-parse "$start^" 2>/dev/null || git merge-base HEAD origin/main)
changed=$({ git diff --name-only "$since"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
forbidden=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '^(openspec/|temporary-docs/|\.gnomish/|\.github/|\.claude/|docs/adr/|CLAUDE\.md$)' | grep -vxF "$change/tasks.md" | grep -v "^$reports/handoff/" || true)
[ -z "$forbidden" ] || { echo "$forbidden"; echo "the implement stage edits only packages/, docs/ outside docs/adr/, the checkboxes of $change/tasks.md and $reports/handoff/ - put changes to these paths into a handoff patch (see .gnomish/stages/specify/handoff.md) and restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; }
dependencies=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '(^|/)(package\.json|pnpm-lock\.yaml)$' || true)
if [ -n "$dependencies" ] && ! grep -qiE 'pnpm add|dependenc|package\.json' "$change/tasks.md"; then echo "$dependencies"; echo "tasks.md asks for no dependency or package.json change - restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; fi

command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
for patch in "$reports"/handoff/*.patch; do
  [ -e "$patch" ] || continue
  git apply --check "$patch" || { echo "$patch does not apply to the branch - regenerate it as .gnomish/stages/specify/handoff.md describes"; exit 1; }
done
if grep -qE '^- H[0-9]+' "$change/tasks.md" && [ ! -f "$reports/handoff/README.md" ]; then
  echo "tasks.md lists handoff items under Human follow-up but $reports/handoff/README.md is missing"; exit 1
fi

Missing: settings 'Icon options' E2E; the outline steps 'the caption and the toggles of the tools group share one row' and 'the tools group is at most 56 px high' (task says grep -c 'tools group' settings_option_group_e2e.feature prints 2); steps/settings_tools_group_e2e.steps.ts; the main-page delta scenarios 'Header with a tool button', 'Title size with a tool button', 'The meeting bar hides the tool buttons' in main_page_header_e2e.feature; and the re-taken settings screenshots with the tools group.
Tasks 3.4/4.5 incomplete: tools_unit.feature lacks 'Place of the tools group' (settings delta), 'One enabled tool' (FR4) and the tools 'English interface' scenario (FR18).

Task 9.8 not done though ticked: unix_time_converter_e2e.feature has only 'Focus on a desktop', 'A typed value is shown in the notations' and 'Long values'. Missing: 'Focus and names' with axe in light and dark at 320/390/1280 (NFR-A4, M6), 'Focus on a touch device' (Pixel 5 context), 'A message is announced once' (NFR-A3), 'Fraction digits follow the precision' in Chromium (M2), 'Copy' with clipboard (FR12), 'The moment is kept while the app is open' (FR14), 'Seconds are dropped' with focus on the tool button (FR16), tools 'Esc inside a field first restores the field', 'Approved screenshots' (4 baselines), and the 22-digit half of 'Long values at 320 px'.

Task 9.6 incomplete: the converter unit features lack spec scenarios 'The reference moment is not read', 'A fixed unit converts a text the user did not type', '12-hour format', 'The zone line follows the moment', 'A time in a DST gap', 'Round trip to the nanosecond' (M4), 'A row change rewrites the input' and 'Seconds are dropped'; FR16 (Show on main page) has no scenario at all.

Spec 'Converter layout' says 'The approved screenshots at 390 px and 1280 px in both themes MUST match', and tasks 9.8/9.9 require four converter baselines linked from docs/design/README.md. Instead docs/design/README.md:64 says 'There are no HTML screens and no screenshot baselines yet', so the spec requirement was dropped without changing the spec.

Missing component and unit tests named by the tasks: src/presenter/unixTime/presentConverterRows.test.ts (task 7.4); src/app/ToolButton.test.tsx (task 4.3); component tests for ConverterInputField.tsx, UnitChoice.tsx, ConverterRow.tsx and MomentNotations.tsx (tasks 9.4/9.5: 'each with a component test'). Only ListConverterView.test.tsx exists under views/unixTimeConverter/list.

Wrong traceability tags against the spec's '<!-- implements ... -->' lines: unix_time_reading_unit.feature tags 'Texts the input reads' @FR7 (spec: FR6), 'Detection by digit count'/'A fixed unit reads a typed number again'/'The unit choice does not touch an ISO 8601 text' @FR8 (spec: FR7), 'The page opens live' @FR6 (spec: FR14), 'The same digits without BigInt' @FR15 (spec: FR8, NFR-P3); unix_time_converter_unit.feature and unix_time_converter_range_unit.feature tag 'Unreadable texts', 'A fraction under a fixed unit' and 'Range' @FR16 (spec: FR15; FR16 is Show on main page); unix_time_converter_e2e.feature tags 'Focus on a desktop' @FR17 (spec: NFR-A2). Task 10.1's grep therefore reports coverage that does not exist.

findings.message: Missing loading state: the unix-time-converter delta spec, 'Requirement: Converter rows', says 'While the list loads it shows the row skeleton.' The proposal UI States Matrix row is 'location list loading | the row skeleton of the main page; the input already works', and ticked task 9.5 requires 'row skeleton while the list loads' in ListConverterView.tsx. In the code, useUnixTimeConverter returns loadStatus (packages/client/src/controller/unixTime/useUnixTimeConverter.ts:119), but UnixTimeConverterPage.tsx drops it. ConverterViewProps (views/unixTimeConverter/converterViewDefinition.ts:23-28) has no load-status field, and ListConverterView.tsx always renders the rows. Nothing under views/unixTimeConverter, tools or presenter/unixTime references loadStatus, a skeleton or loading. Fix: pass the load status to the converter view, render the main page's row skeleton (the shared skeleton block) in place of the rows while the list loads, keep the input working, and add a component test plus a BDD scenario for the loading state.
